- The speaker welcomes viewers back to another 3D printing Studio Vlog, stating they are in the middle of production and spend most mornings checking on 3D prints to ensure smooth operation.

text_desc:
- The speaker explains that delivering education via smartphone is like hoping people will eat broccoli when the "most delicious dessert ever made" is right next to it.
- To deliver education to everyone, it must be accessible and make people want to learn, which the speaker states "at the highest level" (0:20) is achieved by "making the broccoli tastes like dessert."
- The speaker then discusses the best time to send notifications, stating it's "24 hours after they use the product last" because if someone was free yesterday at 3 p.m., they are "probably free today at 3 p.m. as well."
- This finding, according to the speaker, is what "a very sophisticated millions of dollars of AI found."
- The speaker notes that "passive aggressive notifications are really good at getting people to come back because they feel like our Green Owl mascot has given up on them."
- The speaker suggests that to get people to do something meaningful, one can "use the same techniques that apps like social media use to get people to do it."
- The speaker concludes by saying that "even if you're not as engaging as those apps are you can still get hundreds of millions of people to use your product."
